sentences.en: This popcorn tastes stale. I wonder when it was popped.
sentences.zh: 这个爆米花尝起来不新鲜。我想知道它是什么时候做的。

sentences.en: The dog ate the stale bread and didn't die.
sentences.zh: 狗吃了陈面包却没有死。

sentences.en: What do you prefer: cold coffee or stale beer?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢冷咖啡还是陈啤酒？

senses.zh: 变陈旧；撒尿；变得不新鲜
